en_US: The books on the third floor are
easy to read.
The ones down here are all too tough
for me to understand...
That tremor...
It was wicked!
I scrambled to find the book
“Disaster Strikes Survival Guide!”
The ceiling-high bookshelves are
crammed with books.
The shelves are lined with books
worn from being read by many people.
Please refrain from bringing food
or beverages into the library.
Well, hello!
We meet again!
After we parted, I went from Oreburgh
to Hearthome, Celestic, then Eterna.
Yes, the town and cities surrounding
the foot of Mt. Coronet.
Why my fascination with Mt. Coronet,
you may ask?
Well, Mt. Coronet happens to be called
“The origin of Sinnoh.”
I learned many things on my journey.
Would you like to hear about them?
Whoa, now let’s not be hasty!
I really want to share this with you!
The way I see it, our world began when
the spirit within people was born.
When that spirit came to be, there
followed awareness about the world.
Within that newborn spirit, time and
space were intertwined as one.
People and Pokémon, too, were but the
same presence.
As I understand it, people and Pokémon
shared the spirit and awareness.
They should have understood and
accepted each other then.
Because they shared the same spirit,
people and Pokémon intermingled.
People took the place of Pokémon,
and the opposite also held true.
That interpretation could give us an
idea about how our world came to be.
A Pokémon is said to have shaped
this world...
Could that Pokémon be the physical form
of the original spirit?
Hmm... The spirit came to be, and from
it, time and space were born...
That seems to point to legendary
DIALGA, the Pokémon of time, and
PALKIA, the Pokémon of space...
And they lead back to ARCEUS, the
Pokémon that made them arise.
Isn’t this interesting?
Would you like to hear some more?
Whoa, please don’t tease me!
I really want to share this with you!
Oh, there were also Plates, weren’t
there?
One Plate read, “Three beings were
born to bind time and space.”
Those three beings I read to mean
the three Pokémon of the lakes.
It’s about UXIE, MESPRIT, and AZELF.
The myth describes how they gave
spirit to the world, shaping it.
But it all starts with ARCEUS, the
first. It is known as the Original One.
Oh, by the way, I wrote down the words
engraved on those Plates.
I summarized them in a book and
donated it to this library.
There it is in that bookshelf.
I’d be pleased if you’d read it.
I have to say I’m glad I came out to
Sinnoh.
I suppose I’d better be off in search
of new myths in faraway lands.
It would be nice if our paths were to
cross again.
”Sinnoh’s Beginning as Told on Plates.”
This is a collection of engravings from
ancient Plates found in Sinnoh.
“The Original One breathed alone before
the universe came.”
“When the universe was created,
its shards became this Plate.”
“The power of defeated giants
infuses this Plate.”
“Two beings of time and space set
free from the Original One.”
“Three beings were born to bind
time and space.”
“Two make matter, and three make
spirit, shaping the world.”
“The powers of Plates are shared
among Pokémon.”
“The rightful bearer of a Plate
draws from the Plate it holds.”
{STRVAR_1 3, 0, 0} returned the book to its
place.
Ah, you must be the new Champion!
I’m the Legend Archivist. I look after
this library’s oldest records.
Since your Hall of Fame entry, people
have reported Pokémon never before
recorded in Sinnoh.
I found them in this tome, the Unova
Chronicle. Unova is a faraway land.
Its legends tell of three Pokémon
who stood together like swords.
And now one of them, VIRIZION, has
been seen in northern Eterna Forest.
How could a Pokémon of Unova come
here? I can’t make sense of it.
Would you look into it for me?
I’ll keep reading the Chronicle.
The Chronicle names all three swords:
COBALION, TERRAKION and VIRIZION.
They never stray far from each other,
and now all three are here in Sinnoh.
Here’s where they’ve been seen:
COBALION: deep inside Iron Island,
in a side cave two floors down.
TERRAKION: in a hollow among the
rocks at the north end of Route 227.
VIRIZION: in the north of Eterna
Forest, by the Old Chateau.
I’ll keep reading the Unova Chronicle.
You found all three swords!
The Chronicle tells of a fourth one,
a young Pokémon named KELDEO.
It followed the three swords to learn
from them, and became a sword itself.
They say it comes to the water when
the three swords are near.
Lake Valor, perhaps? Go there with
COBALION, TERRAKION and VIRIZION.
KELDEO too! All four swords of Unova,
here in Sinnoh...
The Chronicle also tells of MELOETTA,
a Pokémon of song.
A composer at Hearthome’s Contest
Hall may know its melody.
And of GENESECT, an ancient Pokémon
that people brought back and changed.
They say Team Galactic tried that
too, in their Veilstone lab.
The Chronicle ends with two dragons,
RESHIRAM and ZEKROM.
They say each one sleeps in a stone
until a hero wakes it.
These two stones came with the
Chronicle. Please, take them.
RESHIRAM: the LIGHT STONE is warm,
like a fire. Try Fuego Ironworks.
ZEKROM: the DARK STONE crackles.
Try the Valley Windworks, at night.
RESHIRAM and ZEKROM, both here!
The Chronicle tells of a third dragon,
KYUREM, left empty when they split.
It sleeps in the ice. Try the icy
chamber in Mt. Coronet by Route 216.
KYUREM too! The Chronicle says it can
join with RESHIRAM or ZEKROM.
These DNA SPLICERS came with the
Chronicle. They join and split them.
The Chronicle also tells of TORNADUS
and THUNDURUS, who ride the clouds.
Have you felt the wild winds and the
storms lately? They must be here!
They never stay in one place. Look
for them all over Sinnoh.
TORNADUS and THUNDURUS roam all
over Sinnoh.
A Pokétch’s Marking Map can show
you where they are.
If one was knocked out, it may come
back after your next Hall of Fame.
You caught TORNADUS and THUNDURUS!
The Chronicle says this REVEAL GLASS
shows their true forms.
LANDORUS, lord of the land, once
stopped the two of them.
Take TORNADUS and THUNDURUS to the
ruins on Route 228, and see!
And ENAMORUS, who brings the spring...
They say it waits by the Flower
Paradise gate on Route 224.
Which legend of the Unova Chronicle
shall I read to you?
Anything else from the Chronicle?
Swords of Justice
Truth and Ideals
Forces of Nature
Other legends
That’s all
RESHIRAM, ZEKROM and KYUREM...
You found all three dragons!
You’ve met all four of the Forces
of Nature!
You found VICTINI, MELOETTA and
GENESECT too!
And of VICTINI, who brings victory
to those it likes.
It loves a view of the sea. Try the
top of Sunyshore’s Vista Lighthouse.
You caught KYUREM! That was the last
legend of the Unova Chronicle.
And look what was tucked behind it:
a second tome, the Kalos Chronicle!
Its legends begin with XERNEAS, who
gives life, and YVELTAL, who takes it.
Which Chronicle shall I read from?
Unova Chronicle
Kalos Chronicle
I’ll keep reading the Chronicles.
Which legend of the Kalos Chronicle
shall I read to you?
Life and Destruction
I’ll keep reading the Kalos Chronicle.
XERNEAS and YVELTAL keep life in
balance, the Chronicle says.
Where one rests, the land blooms.
Where the other rests, it withers.
Here’s where they’ve been seen:
XERNEAS: in Eterna Forest, in the
green nook beside the Old Chateau.
YVELTAL: on the top floor of the
Lost Tower, on Route 209.
XERNEAS and YVELTAL, both here!
The Chronicle tells of a third one,
ZYGARDE, who keeps them in order.
It watches from deep below. Try the
lowest floor of Wayward Cave.
XERNEAS, YVELTAL and ZYGARDE...
You found all three!
The Chronicle also tells of DIANCIE,
a jewel born among CARBINK.
A CARBINK might lead you to it,
deep in Oreburgh Mine.
And of HOOPA, a prankster that was
sealed away in a bottle.
This PRISON BOTTLE came with the
Chronicle. Please, take it.
HOOPA: they say it plays in the
deepest room of the Solaceon Ruins.
Take the PRISON BOTTLE there!
And of VOLCANION, who lives in heat
and steam.
Try the end of the long tunnel in
Stark Mountain’s first cave.
You found DIANCIE, HOOPA and
VOLCANION too!
XERNEAS and YVELTAL, the heart of
the Kalos Chronicle, both caught!
And look! A third tome has opened:
the Alola Chronicle!
Alola is a land of islands. Its
legends tell of guardians, and of
Pokémon that came from the sky.
Alola Chronicle
Which legend of the Alola Chronicle
shall I read to you?
I’ll keep reading the Alola Chronicle.
Island Guardians
Sun and Moon
Each island of Alola has a guardian,
the Chronicle says. Four of them!
They like the sea and the flowers.
Here’s where they’ve been seen:
TAPU KOKO: on the beach at the
east end of Route 222.
TAPU LELE: in the grove on
Fullmoon Island.
TAPU BULU: among the flowers of
Floaroma Meadow.
TAPU FINI: on a little beach out
at sea, on Route 226.
All four guardians of Alola...
You found every one!
The Chronicle tells of COSMOG, a
little Pokémon from beyond the sky.
It appears where the sky is thin...
Spear Pillar, perhaps?
Raise your COSMOG well. The
Chronicle says it becomes COSMOEM,
then SOLGALEO with a SUN STONE,
or LUNALA with a MOON STONE.
Another COSMOG may wait at Spear
Pillar now, for the other form!
And the Chronicle warns of NECROZMA,
who steals the light.
It follows the sun and the moon to
Spear Pillar...
Two COSMOG and NECROZMA...
The legends of the sky are yours!
NECROZMA too! The Chronicle says it
can join with SOLGALEO or LUNALA.
These two came with the Chronicle:
the N-SOLARIZER and N-LUNARIZER.
Ultra Beasts
The Chronicle tells of Ultra Beasts
from beyond holes in the sky.
They say NECROZMA opens the way.
Find it first!
Since you caught NECROZMA, Ultra
Beasts have been seen in Sinnoh!
Here’s where:
NIHILEGO: on the lowest floor of
Iron Island.
BUZZWOLE: at the north end of
Route 225.
PHEROMOSA: in a quiet corner of
Route 229.
XURKITREE: by the walkways of
Sunyshore City.
CELESTEELA: high on the snowy
slopes of Mt. Coronet.
KARTANA: in the east of
Eterna Forest.
GUZZLORD: in the first room of
Turnback Cave.
STAKATAKA: in a hollow on
Route 227.
BLACEPHALON: outside Stark Mountain,
near the entrance.
All nine Ultra Beasts... The holes
in the sky have closed.
